summary_en: 3,000,000 ordinary shares to be cancelled on 2026-06-23. Post-cancellation issued shares: 86,015,815 (from 89,015,815 pre-cancellation). Treasury holdings post-cancellation: 1,204,485 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 11 June 2026, the board of directors of Daiho Corporation resolved, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act, to cancel 3,000,000 treasury shares of common stock. The cancellation is scheduled for 23 June 2026. Prior to cancellation, issued shares total 89,015,815; the 3,000,000 shares to be cancelled represent 3.37% of that pre-cancellation base. Post-cancellation, issued shares will number 86,015,815, and treasury holdings will decrease to 1,204,485 shares. All figures are as of 31 May 2026.
